reader.requirement: At --std 85, for an indexed file whose FD is EXTERNAL, every file control entry of the run unit describing that connector must name an alternate key of the same data description and relative location, the same number of alternate keys and the same DUPLICATES phrase: a run unit whose entries differ in any of these is refused, and a run unit whose entries agree shares one connector with that one set of alternate keys; the witnesses cover only the refusal half (and for access mode, not for alternate keys).

reader.notes: The refusal half conforms: COBOL6847 refuses each disagreement GR5 lists, through FileEntryIdentity's ALT segment. The agreeing half fails: FileRegistry.RegisterIndexed returns early for an ::EXT:: connector already registered, but FileRegistry.AddAlternateKey has no such guard, so every further describer appends its alternate keys again to the one shared IndexedConnector; its declared key table then disagrees with the stored one and OPEN INPUT gets '39'. Separately compiled describers (the runtime ExternalTable path) were not probed.
